notes: Card: ' (' x5, '&' x2, '（', plus HTML entity pieces (or, til, psi) in a table. Probes: ' (' after / 0.981, '（' after ? 0.767, ' (' after $ 0.435; '(near Dayton)' 0.002, plain text under 0.05. The entity-table cluster is outside this label. Near misses keep parentheses after ordinary words, so ' (' alone cannot pass.
